profile_text.body:
ClassDojo is a K-12 classroom communication platform that connects teachers with families. According to its website, it offers free classroom communication, behavior tracking, and student portfolios, and the company says it is used in 95% of US schools. Its Messages feature lets teachers, families, and staff communicate and is automatically translated into more than 190+ languages. Stories lets teachers share photos, videos, and updates on a private feed, while Points and Big Ideas support social-emotional learning and Portfolios give students a place to show their work. A Teacher Toolkit covers tools such as attendance sheets and timers.

The site's AI-related feature is the automatic translation of messages. The product is listed under Education & Research AI, with use spanning class communication, portfolios, and points for teachers, families, and students. Pricing is free for teachers, schools, and districts, with an optional ClassDojo Plus family subscription. The listing notes that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and has not been independently verified, that student age and privacy details are not verified, and that it rests on third-party sources only.
